text: Decision: remove the coarse ms-v05 milestone dependency. EyeLink ASC now has its own explicit timeline prerequisite (bd-01KYDZ6D3VG604H88PR7G8JQCR), FS2 adapter prerequisite, trusted-session materializer, and reliability epic. Relational-analysis and generic-codec work remaining in ms-v05 neither supplies nor changes the parser contract; retaining the edge would make unrelated roadmap breadth falsely gate completed ingestion semantics.
